description: Open a task for people on the project, for example the translation task for strings you just added. Give the keys in `labels`, or a `namespace`, so its progress tracks the work, and set auto_complete to close it by itself when the values are done. Needs the developer role. It defaults to the token's base branch.

auto_complete.description: Complete the task by itself when its scope reaches this state.

branch.description: Branch to operate on. Defaults to the token's base (bound) branch. May name any branch in the token's allowed set: its base branch, plus branches this token created (only when the token's scope is create-own; see list_branches). Naming any other branch fails with branch_not_allowed.

languages.description: Languages it covers. Default: every target language.

name: create_task
title: Create Task
